shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && rg --files app lib components data | sort'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts lib/products.ts 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' tsconfig.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > tsconfig.json <<'EOF'
{
  \"compilerOptions\": {
    \"target\": \"ES2017\",
    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
    \"allowJs\": true,
    \"skipLibCheck\": true,
    \"strict\": true,
    \"noEmit\": true,
    \"esModuleInterop\": true,
    \"module\": \"esnext\",
    \"moduleResolution\": \"bundler\",
    \"resolveJsonModule\": true,
    \"isolatedModules\": true,
    \"jsx\": \"react-jsx\",
    \"incremental\": true,
    \"plugins\": [{ \"name\": \"next\" }],
    \"paths\": { \"@/*\": [\"./*\"] }
  },
  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\", \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"],
  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\", \"EVAL.ts\"]
}
EOF"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/layout.tsx app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json"
